classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate, evaluate, rank, and explicitly submit a final acceptable 75-residue de novo single-chain protein design, with enough evidence to return final Reason: and Answer: fields.
assumptions: A compact single-chain 75-residue monomer can be pursued with the validated de novo backbone-design template using unconditional RFdiffusion backbone generation followed by ProteinMPNN sequence design and Protenix-v2 refolding.

'Stable fold' will be operationally judged in silico from the ranked top candidate using refold confidence together with structure-analysis and protein-QC outputs; no experimental stability data is available in this workflow.
The requested final response fields will be populated from the ranked top design via explicit final submission when the top candidate passes the workflow's acceptance threshold.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round
workflow_plan.description: Generate one RFdiffusion backbone, design sequences, refold, analyze structure, QC, and rank candidates.

success_criteria.Reason: Provide a concise justification for why the submitted top design was selected, grounded in refold confidence, structural compactness/single-chain fold consistency, and QC/ranking results.
success_criteria.Answer: Provide the final submitted top design sequence as the primary answer, identifying it as the accepted 75-residue de novo candidate.
success_criteria.final_submission: Use rank_designs to choose the top candidate, then explicitly submit the final top design only if its combined refold/analysis/QC profile is acceptable.
